arguments.name: name
arguments.description: (Required) The name of the global table. Must match underlying DynamoDB Table names in all regions.

arguments.name: replica
arguments.description: (Required) Underlying DynamoDB Table. At least 1 replica must be defined. See below.

arguments.name: regionName
arguments.description: (Required) AWS region name of replica DynamoDB TableE.g., `us-east-1`
